Package com.miniandmore.app.service

Class ZohoStockReconcileService

java.lang.Object
com.miniandmore.app.service.ZohoStockReconcileService
@Service public class ZohoStockReconcileService extends Object
Reconciles store catalog stock to Zoho stock_on_hand without pushing product metadata. Used by stock webhooks, admin retries, and post-invoice correction.
